request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material, fabric, metal and fur texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, including on clothing, collars, bags, vehicles, plates and walls. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Keep the main subject of the photo whole inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps it whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.

One very BIG red backpack beside a chair, in a bright empty hallway with a pale stone-tile floor and a plain white wall. A huge, fully packed, bright-red hiking backpack stands upright on the floor directly beside a simple light-oak wooden dining chair with a straight slatted backrest and no cushion. The backpack is enormous next to the chair: its top is clearly HIGHER than the chair's seat and reaches almost to the top of the backrest, and it is as wide as the chair. The whole backpack is one plain bright red with red straps and red pockets, with no other color on it. The camera is at seat height, straight on. The whole backpack and the whole chair are sharp, touch the floor, and stand close together inside the central 55 percent of the photo width. Exactly one bag and one chair; no people, no animals, no other bags, no shoes, no coats and nothing on the chair.
